description: Compare swap routes across every available aggregator and rank by NET output (after gas and fees), not headline quote. Returns the winner plus all runners-up so the ranking can be checked rather than trusted. Ranks after ~1.2s once 2+ sources answered: any source still pending is listed in `late` with `complete: false` (late, not failed -- it could beat the returned route). This display ranking may be incomplete; prepare_best_route re-ranks with every source.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 8453 for Base

taker.description: address used for quoting only; nothing is signed

name: best_swap_route
